prompt: Make this paragraph easier for a general audience to understand: 'The room booking procedure comprises submission of an intended usage interval, subsequent availability verification, and issuance of an acknowledgement. An acknowledgement of receipt does not constitute approval of the requested interval.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: To book a room, first submit the dates and times you would like to use it. We will then check whether the room is available and let you know that we received your request. Please note that this confirmation only means we have received your booking request—it does not mean the room has been approved or reserved. Your booking is confirmed only after we have checked availability and given you formal approval.
